founded_year.notes: Appspace careers page says the company was founded in 2002.

last_funding.notes: Accel-KKR and Appspace announced a strategic growth investment on September 21, 2023; the public announcement disclosed no amount. Amount is represented as 0 because the schema requires a number, not as a claim that the investment was zero.

model_provider.notes: Appspace’s June 16, 2026 BYOM announcement names these supported providers.

named_customers.notes: Both appear by name in Appspace case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Appspace has an open-positions page, but the pages accessible in this review did not list an AI, ML, data-science or related scientist role. Current listing details may change.

hq_location.notes: Company SOC report states Tampa, Florida headquarters; Gartner lists Tampa, FL, United States.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Center links to multiple product documentation categories and articles.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding announcement was September 21, 2023, outside the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: Appspace careers page says the company was founded in 2002.

last_funding.notes: Accel-KKR and Appspace announced a strategic growth investment on September 21, 2023; the public announcement disclosed no amount. Amount is represented as 0 because the schema requires a number, not as a claim that the investment was zero.

launched_6mo.notes: Appspace announced its bring-your-own-model enterprise AI offering on June 16, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Free, Express and Enterprise plans, although it does not state dollar prices.

employee_band.notes: Gartner Peer Insights company details report 201–500 employees; other third-party workforce estimates vary, so this uses the requested band supported by a cited company profile.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current job listing identified an SMB Account Executive role; Appspace's careers page links to its open positions.

model_provider.notes: Appspace’s June 16, 2026 BYOM announcement names these supported providers.
model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Google Gemini (BYOM); organizations connect these through their own AI environments and API keys.

named_customers.notes: Both appear by name in Appspace case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Appspace has an open-positions page, but the pages accessible in this review did not list an AI, ML, data-science or related scientist role. Current listing details may change.

compliance_certs.notes: The security exhibit says Appspace is SOC-2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 compliant. Only requested certifications are included.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed job/careers, public documentation, and integration-related sources did not establish a CRM or sales/marketing system used internally by Appspace.

product_one_liner.notes: Homepage presents Appspace as a workplace experience platform and lists communications, signage, workspace and visitor products.
product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace experience platform for organizations that combines employee communications and intranet with digital signage, workspace/space reservation, and visitor management.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 19, 2026, Appspace announced the appointments of Eric Daggett as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer.
